SUBJECT: slender adult European-looking woman with dark chestnut braided bun, ivory and navy scholar dress with fitted sleeves, gold celestial embroidery, burgundy waist ribbon and black boots. Pull spear back, lower stance, powerful two-handed forward thrust then recover. ROW3 hit recoil and recovery; ROW4 defensive guard and recovery using this actual equipment, no extra sword; ROW5 evasive crouch step then recovery; ROW6 collapse/defeat ending lying motionless. SAME costume throughout: slender adult European-looking woman with dark chestnut braided bun, ivory and navy scholar dress with fitted sleeves, gold celestial embroidery, burgundy waist ribbon and black boots. Weapon must remain recognizable, same proportions, grip anatomically correct. No swords except those explicitly requested. No touching neighbours. Solid opaque magenta everywhere between characters, no transparency.
